prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective walking along Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, under a clear sunny sky during the day. The camera moves steadily forward, capturing the rugged terrain composed of large reddish-brown rocks interspersed with patches of green vegetation. As the viewer progresses, the camera pans slightly to reveal the expansive blue ocean on the left, its waves gently crashing against the rocky shore. The path continues inland, transitioning from the rocky beach to a more forested area with dense greenery and scattered trees. The camera angle shifts subtly, providing a broader view of the surrounding landscape, which includes rolling hills covered in shrubs and small plants. The sunlight filters through the leaves, casting dappled shadows on the ground, enhancing the vibrant colors of the natural environment. The scene remains empty, with no visible crowds, emphasizing the serene and untouched beauty of the location. The camera maintains a consistent pace, offering a continuous and immersive experience of the outdoor-natural setting.
